text: # A Swift Tour: Explore Swift’s features and design ## ✨ 개요 - 세션 주제: **A Swift Tour: Explore Swift’s features and design** - 세션 링크: `https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2024/10184/` - 핵심 소개: 세션 소개 및 Transcript를 기반으로 핵심 내용을 정리했습니다. - 왜 중요한지: 언어 기능 선택이 타입 안정성·동시성 안정성·재사용성에 직접 영향을 주기 때문입니다. - 언제 쓰는지: Swift 코드베이스의 설계 원칙을 정리하거나 팀 코드리뷰 기준을 만들 때 특히 유용합니다. - 이 세션에서 특히 봐야 할 포인트 - 예제를 하나의 Swift Package(라이브러리 + HTTP 서버 + CLI)로 확장하며 Swift를 범용 언어로 설명합니다. - 값 타입/에러 모델링/패키지 구조화/프로토콜/동시성/언어 확장성까지를 하나의 흐름으로 연결합니다. - Hummingbird(서버)와 swift-argument-parser(CLI)를 예시로 사용해 실제 프로젝트 구조까지 보여줍니다. - `Introduction`: Hi, I’m Allan Shortlidge and I work on the Swift compiler. ## 🧭 구조 - 세션은 챕터 기준으로 점진적으로 개념/구현/운영 포인트를 쌓는 구조입니다. - 챕터 흐름 요약 - **Introduction** - Hi, I’m Allan Shortlidge and I work on the Swift compiler. - Today, I’m excited to give you a tour of my favorite programming language: Swift. - **Agenda** - Today we’re going to take a tour of the core features of Swift. - We won’t cover every aspect of it or go deep on any one topic. - **The example** - While I introduce you to Swift, I’m going to demonstrate its features by building infrastructure for the next great social network. - The code will be organized into a Swift package that has three components: The first is a library that provides the data model for representing users in a graph. - **Value types** - let’s start with a fundamental programming concept: Representing data. - The primary way you represent data in Swift is with value types. - **Errors and optionals** - Disks fill up, network connections fail, and users provide bad data. - Swift provides an error handling model that makes it easy to report errors and gracefully handle them. - **Code organization** - and now I think it’s time to start adding some structure to the code. - Two units of code organization supported by Swift are modules and packages. - **Classes** - Up until now I’ve only talked about value types, but sometimes you need to represent shared mutable state. - For that, Swift has reference types, like classes. - **Protocols** - inheritance is the main mechanism for polymorphism. - In Swift, though, protocols provide a more general way to build abstractions, and they work equally well with both value and reference types. - **Concurrency** - Okay, before we move on to building an HTTP server, there’s one more important Swift concept I want to tell you about first, which is concurrency. - Calls to actor methods from outside the context of the actor are asynchronous. - **Extensibility** - The final category of Swift features we’ll cover have to do with extending the language. - These powerful features are often used by library authors to build expressive, type-safe APIs and eliminate boilerplate code in your applications. - 세션의 핵심은 단순 API 사용법보다, **문제를 어떻게 모델링하고 어떤 레이어에 배치하는지**를 보여주는 데 있습니다. - 같은 기능도 Apple 권장 패턴을 따르면 상태 관리·에러 처리·성능 최적화 포인트가 더 명확해집니다. - 실전 도입은 전체 교체보다 “파일럿 적용 → 패턴 검증 → 공통화” 순서가 리스크를 줄입니다. - 특히 이 세션은 Swift를 단순 앱 개발 언어가 아니라 서버/CLI/패키지까지 포함한 범용 언어로 보여주며, 언어 기능 선택을 시스템 설계 관점으로 끌어올립니다. ## 🧪 실전 포인트 - 아키텍처: 세션에서 제시한 패턴을 전체 코드베이스에 즉시 적용하기보다, 변동성이 큰 모듈/화면/플로우부터 파일럿 적용 후 표준화하세요. - UX: 언어 수준의 선택(값/참조, 에러 모델, 동시성)은 앱의 안정성과 반응성으로 이어집니다. - 주의사항: 데모 코드는 개념 전달 중심인 경우가 많으므로, 프로덕션 적용 시에는 오류 처리, 취소, 로깅, 관측성(metrics), 롤백 전략을 보강해야 합니다. - 설계 판단 기준: 도입 이점(가독성/성능/안정성/개발속도)과 비용(학습/마이그레이션/테스트/호환성)을 팀 단위로 비교해 우선순위를 정하세요. - 세션 기반 체크포인트 - `Agenda`: Today we’re going to take a tour of the core features of Swift. - `The example`: While I introduce you to Swift, I’m going to demonstrate its features by building infrastructure for the next great social network. - `Value types`: let’s start with a fundamental programming concept: Representing data. - `Errors and optionals`: Disks fill up, network connections fail, and users provide bad data. ## ✅ 핵심 정리 - 이 세션은 **A Swift Tour: Explore Swift’s features and design**를 단순 기능 소개가 아니라, 실제 제품/서비스 코드에 적용할 때 필요한 설계 판단 관점까지 연결해 이해하는 데 가치가 있습니다. - 특히 실무에서는 “무엇을 도입할까”보다 “어떤 문제에 어떤 경계와 패턴으로 적용할까”를 합의하는 기준 문서로 활용하기 좋습니다. 핵심 메시지 한 문장: 세션의 핵심은 API 사용법 자체보다, 제품 요구사항과 운영 조건에 맞춰 도입 범위와 설계 경계를 판단하는 기준을 만드는 데 있습니다.

text: # Animate with springs ## ✨ 개요 - 세션 주제: **Animate with springs** - 세션 링크: `https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2023/10158/` - 핵심 소개: 세션 소개 및 Transcript를 기반으로 핵심 내용을 정리했습니다. - 왜 중요한지: 디자인 시스템/상태 흐름/UI 구조 선택이 화면 완성도와 유지보수성을 크게 좌우하기 때문입니다. - 언제 쓰는지: 디자인 변경 반영, 신규 화면 설계, SwiftUI 리팩터링 시 적용 기준으로 쓰기 좋습니다. - 이 세션에서 특히 봐야 할 포인트 - `Why springs`: Let's examine a context where we have a few animations: a simple toggle. - `How springs work`: When we use a spring animation, we're modeling it with the motion of an object attached to a spring. - `How to use springs`: Because springs are such a great tool for animations, we now use them as the default animation in SwiftUI, so all you need to do is call withAnimation to start with a spring. ## 🧭 구조 - 세션은 챕터 기준으로 점진적으로 개념/구현/운영 포인트를 쌓는 구조입니다. - 챕터 흐름 요약 - **Why springs** - Let's examine a context where we have a few animations: a simple toggle. - Let's focus in on this toggle. - **How springs work** - When we use a spring animation, we're modeling it with the motion of an object attached to a spring. - If we go back to physics, this motion is defined by 3 properties: the object's mass, the spring's stiffness, and the damping of the system, which is a measure of how much friction is applied to the object by its surroundings. - **How to use springs** - Because springs are such a great tool for animations, we now use them as the default animation in SwiftUI, so all you need to do is call withAnimation to start with a spring. - We've also made it easier to explicitly use springs for animations. - 실전 해석: 초반 챕터는 개념 정의, 중반은 구성/API 적용, 후반은 운영/확장 포인트로 읽으면 팀 공유 자료로 활용하기 좋습니다. ## 🛠️ 세부 API - 세션에서 반복적으로 등장하거나 설계상 중요한 API/개념 - **SwiftUI** - 왜 중요한지: 이 세션의 핵심 구현 전략 또는 설계 판단 포인트를 구성하는 요소입니다. - 언제 쓰는지: 실제 기능 구현/리팩터링/마이그레이션 설계 시 우선 검토 대상입니다. - **UIKit** - 왜 중요한지: 이 세션의 핵심 구현 전략 또는 설계 판단 포인트를 구성하는 요소입니다. - 언제 쓰는지: 실제 기능 구현/리팩터링/마이그레이션 설계 시 우선 검토 대상입니다. - **actor** - 왜 중요한지: 이 세션의 핵심 구현 전략 또는 설계 판단 포인트를 구성하는 요소입니다. - 언제 쓰는지: 실제 기능 구현/리팩터링/마이그레이션 설계 시 우선 검토 대상입니다. - 실전 개발자 관점: API 이름 자체보다 **상태 경계, 에러 처리, 성능 영향, 테스트 전략**까지 함께 봐야 재사용 가능한 패턴이 됩니다. ## 🔍 차이점 - 세션의 핵심은 단순 API 사용법보다, **문제를 어떻게 모델링하고 어떤 레이어에 배치하는지**를 보여주는 데 있습니다. - 같은 기능도 Apple 권장 패턴을 따르면 상태 관리·에러 처리·성능 최적화 포인트가 더 명확해집니다. - 실전 도입은 전체 교체보다 “파일럿 적용 → 패턴 검증 → 공통화” 순서가 리스크를 줄입니다. ## 🧪 실전 포인트 - 아키텍처: 세션에서 제시한 패턴을 전체 코드베이스에 즉시 적용하기보다, 변동성이 큰 모듈/화면/플로우부터 파일럿 적용 후 표준화하세요. - UX: 상태/레이아웃/상호작용 설계 품질이 사용자 체감 완성도에 바로 반영됩니다. - 주의사항: 데모 코드는 개념 전달 중심인 경우가 많으므로, 프로덕션 적용 시에는 오류 처리, 취소, 로깅, 관측성(metrics), 롤백 전략을 보강해야 합니다. - 설계 판단 기준: 도입 이점(가독성/성능/안정성/개발속도)과 비용(학습/마이그레이션/테스트/호환성)을 팀 단위로 비교해 우선순위를 정하세요. - 세션 기반 체크포인트 ## ✅ 핵심 정리 - 이 세션은 **Animate with springs**를 단순 기능 소개가 아니라, 실제 제품/서비스 코드에 적용할 때 필요한 설계 판단 관점까지 연결해 이해하는 데 가치가 있습니다. - 특히 실무에서는 “무엇을 도입할까”보다 “어떤 문제에 어떤 경계와 패턴으로 적용할까”를 합의하는 기준 문서로 활용하기 좋습니다. 핵심 메시지 한 문장: 세션의 핵심은 API 사용법 자체보다, 제품 요구사항과 운영 조건에 맞춰 도입 범위와 설계 경계를 판단하는 기준을 만드는 데 있습니다.

title: Break into the RealityKit debugger
text: # Break into the RealityKit debugger ## ✨ 개요 - 세션 주제: **Break into the RealityKit debugger** - 세션 링크: `https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2024/10172/` - 핵심 소개: 세션 소개 및 Transcript를 기반으로 핵심 내용을 정리했습니다. - 왜 중요한지: 공간 컴퓨팅은 3D 렌더링·입력·성능·몰입감이 동시에 맞아야 해서 설계 판단 기준이 중요합니다. - 언제 쓰는지: 2D 앱을 visionOS/3D 경험으로 확장하거나 SceneKit→RealityKit 전환을 검토할 때 유용합니다. - 이 세션에서 특히 봐야 할 포인트 - `Introduction`: Hey, I’m Jeremiah! - `Agenda`: We’ll begin with a quick tour of the RealityKit Debugger, which we will then use to inspect an app and track down some bugs. - `Prepare for the Journey`: With RealityKit you can build jaw-dropping 3D apps, and deploy them to iOS, macOS and visionOS. - `Meet the RealityKit debugger`: The RealityKit Debugger takes a 3D snapshot of your running app, and loads it in Xcode for you to explore. ## 🧭 구조 - 세션은 챕터 기준으로 점진적으로 개념/구현/운영 포인트를 쌓는 구조입니다. - 챕터 흐름 요약 - **Introduction** - Hey, I’m Jeremiah! - I make developer tools that help you make awesome spatial apps and games. - **Agenda** - We’ll begin with a quick tour of the RealityKit Debugger, which we will then use to inspect an app and track down some bugs. - We’ll traverse entity hierarchies, in search of unexpected transformations; address bad behaviors in our systems, by exposing the mistakes in our components; we’ll find missing content, when we overcome some rendering pitfalls; and finally, I’ll share some tips & tricks for adapting the RealityKit Debugger to the uniqueness of your app. - **Prepare for the Journey** - Are you ready? - With RealityKit you can build jaw-dropping 3D apps, and deploy them to iOS, macOS and visionOS. - **Meet the RealityKit debugger** - The RealityKit Debugger takes a 3D snapshot of your running app, and loads it in Xcode for you to explore. - It also reconstructs the content in a 3D viewport. - **Transform the BOTanist** - Now, with our new tool in hand, let’s go and fix up this club. - The code patch for transforming the sample is pretty big. - **Traverse hierarchy issues** - Before we dive in, let’s take a moment to consider, how Transformation hierarchies work. - When you place content in a 3D scene, you set a position, orientation and scale. - **Address bad behaviors** - The transformed club is starting to look the part. - And now it’s time to bring some of these objects to life. - **Find what's missing** - We now have robots teleporting in, but there’a a problem! - 3D renderers like RealityKit achieve their performance in part, by being selective of what they spend time rendering. - **Embrace uniqueness** - From rogue transformations, through to misconfigured components, and rendering gotchas, we’ve already covered many of the common problems you might encounter when building your own apps. - But many parts of an app are unique. - **Wrap up** - With the problem identified, we can now head to the code to fix it. - In the dance system when the target is set, I should be removing the Newcomer component, but I’m not. - text: # Bring context to today’s weather ## ✨ 개요 - 세션 주제: **Bring context to today’s weather** - 세션 링크: `https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2024/10067/` - 핵심 소개: 세션 소개 및 Transcript를 기반으로 핵심 내용을 정리했습니다. - `Highlight weather changes`: At this time, I would like to talk about making sense of the rich weather data that you can get with WeatherKit, in the global historical context. - `Faster data transfer`: So, we have also made it easy to receive weather data from our most data-intensive APIs. ## 🧭 구조 - text: # Bring expression to your app with Genmoji ## ✨ 개요 - 세션 주제: **Bring expression to your app with Genmoji** - 세션 링크: `https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2024/10220/` - 핵심 소개: 세션 소개 및 Transcript를 기반으로 핵심 내용을 정리했습니다. - 왜 중요한지: 배포/운영 자동화는 개발 속도와 운영 리스크를 동시에 줄여 팀 생산성에 직접 영향을 주기 때문입니다. - 언제 쓰는지: CI/CD 고도화, TestFlight 운영 자동화, App Store 운영 자동화 설계 시 유용합니다. - 이 세션에서 특히 봐야 할 포인트 - `Introduction`: Hi, I'm Aaron, an engineer for the Input Experience team. - `Express yourself`: Emoji are everywhere! - `Emoji enhancements`: This includes an updated emoji keyboard that takes the standard emoji we all know and love and combines it with your personalized content that can now be used like an emoji. - `NSAdaptiveImageGlyph`: Introducing NSAdaptiveImageGlyph, a brand new API to support using Genmoji and other personalized images just like a standard emoji! ## 🧭 구조 - 세션은 챕터 기준으로 점진적으로 개념/구현/운영 포인트를 쌓는 구조입니다. - 챕터 흐름 요약 - **Introduction** - Hi, I'm Aaron, an engineer for the Input Experience team. - Today, I'm happy to share with you some exciting new ways to enhance your app’s expressiveness with emoji. - **Express yourself** - Emoji are everywhere! - And why shouldn’t they be? - **Emoji enhancements** - This includes an updated emoji keyboard that takes the standard emoji we all know and love and combines it with your personalized content that can now be used like an emoji. - We’re talking Stickers, Memoji, Animoji, and a brand new way to make your own emoji called Genmoji. - **NSAdaptiveImageGlyph** - Introducing NSAdaptiveImageGlyph, a brand new API to support using Genmoji and other personalized images just like a standard emoji! - NSAdaptiveImageGlyphs are powered by a standard image format in a square aspect ratio with multiple resolutions, and bolstered by additional metadata such as a globally unique and stable identifier a content description that can be used for accessibility, and alignment metrics to allow proper layout and placement of images so they can be used with and formatted alongside regular text. - **Adopting in your app** - Now, let's take a look at just how easy it can be to support Genmoji in your application. - NSAdaptiveImageGlyph is natively supported by rich TextViews. - **Compatibility** - let's take a moment to talk about important compatibility considerations for your app. - Like the text they are displayed with, image glyphs carry important semantic meaning that may be lost or altered if not properly conveyed so care must be taken when handling fallback behavior in unsupported contexts. - **Advanced usage** - While it might be easiest to get started with Genmoji by supporting rich text, image glyphs can be fully supported by third party data formats and completely custom text engines. - In addition to supporting image glyphs in existing UI text elements across all Apple platforms including text views, content editable WebViews, and SwitfUI text, custom text engines built with existing Apple frameworks such as TextKit and CoreText can take advantage of updated text rendering APIs to provide custom solutions for Genmoji. - **Wrap-up** - to the emoji experience available across all Apple platforms, including a brand new emoji keyboard, custom emoji creation with Genmoji, and multiple ways to support expressive images in your app with NSAdaptiveImageGlyph. - Whether using standard rich text views or a managing a fully custom typesetting solution, I encourage you to check out the latest SDK and see how easy it is to open up a whole new world of self-expression in your app with Genmoji. - text: # Build compelling spatial photo and video experiences ## ✨ 개요 - 세션 주제: **Build compelling spatial photo and video experiences** - 세션 링크: `https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2024/10166/` - `Types of stereoscopic experiences`: Let's start by looking at the different types of stereo video. - `Tour of the new APIs`: In this section, we'll go over three new areas of APIs. - `Deep dive into spatial media formats`: At a file format level, a spatial video is a stereo MV-HEVC video with extra spatial metadata. ## 🧭 구조 - 세션은 챕터 기준으로 점진적으로 개념/구현/운영 포인트를 쌓는 구조입니다. - 챕터 흐름 요약 - **Introduction** - Hi, I'm Vedant, an engineer on Apple Vision Pro. - In this session, I'll be showing you how to build compelling experiences with Spatial Photos and Spatial Videos. - **Types of stereoscopic experiences** - Let's start by looking at the different types of stereo video. - First there's 3D video, like the 3D movies available in the AppleTV and Disney+ apps. - **Tour of the new APIs** - In this section, we'll go over three new areas of APIs. - Recording spatial videos, detecting if a file is spatial and loading it, and different options for presenting it on visionOS. - **Deep dive into spatial media formats** - At a file format level, a spatial video is a stereo MV-HEVC video with extra spatial metadata. - And a spatial photo is a stereo HEIC, with two images in a stereo group, along with some spatial metadata. - text: # Create enhanced spatial computing experiences with ARKit ## ✨ 개요 - 세션 주제: **Create enhanced spatial computing experiences with ARKit** - 세션 링크: `https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2024/10100/` - 핵심 소개: 세션 소개 및 Transcript를 기반으로 핵심 내용을 정리했습니다. - 왜 중요한지: 공간 컴퓨팅은 3D 렌더링·입력·성능·몰입감이 동시에 맞아야 해서 설계 판단 기준이 중요합니다. - 언제 쓰는지: 2D 앱을 visionOS/3D 경험으로 확장하거나 SceneKit→RealityKit 전환을 검토할 때 유용합니다. - 이 세션에서 특히 봐야 할 포인트 - `Introduction`: Hi, my name is Divyesh. - `Room tracking`: Many apps on visionOS are set within the room a person is in. - `Plane detection`: Next, let’s talk about an update to plane detection. - `Object tracking`: Now, let’s take a look at object tracking, which is new to visionOS. ## 🧭 구조 - 세션은 챕터 기준으로 점진적으로 개념/구현/운영 포인트를 쌓는 구조입니다. - 챕터 흐름 요약 - **Introduction** - Hi, my name is Divyesh. - In this session, you’ll learn about some exciting updates coming to ARKit on visionOS. - **Room tracking** - Many apps on visionOS are set within the room a person is in. - With mesh and plane anchor data, you can already augment the setting with realistically placed virtual content. - **Plane detection** - Next, let’s talk about an update to plane detection. - As ARKit detects planar surfaces in your surroundings, it can give you information about them in the form of PlaneAnchors. - **Object tracking** - Now, let’s take a look at object tracking, which is new to visionOS. - ARKit can now track real-world objects that are statically placed in your environment. - **World tracking** - Now, I’ll share some improvements to world tracking, which is a foundational part of this platform. - ARKit relies on a variety of cameras and sensors to run sophisticated algorithms, like world tracking. - **Hand tracking** - Lastly, I’ll cover some advancements in hand tracking, which is a primary means of input on this platform. - `Agenda`: I will start with an overview of what modules are, then explain how modules are used to build your code, then cover the differences you will see in the new Xcode, and finally co... - `What are modules?`: At their core, modules are units of code distribution that describe the interface of a library or framework. - `Using modules`: When the compiler encounters an import, it first discovers which module that import refers to, and then obtains the compiled representation of that module. ## 🧭 구조 - 세션은 챕터 기준으로 점진적으로 개념/구현/운영 포인트를 쌓는 구조입니다. - I will start with an overview of what modules are, then explain how modules are used to build your code, then cover the differences you will see in the new Xcode, and finally cover how to optimize your build by maximizing reuse of already-built modules. - **What are modules?** - At their core, modules are units of code distribution that describe the interface of a library or framework. - A Swift target contains multiple Swift files that together represent a module, and in general, all the Swift source files in a single target or framework are part of the same module. - **Using modules** - When the compiler encounters an import, it first discovers which module that import refers to, and then obtains the compiled representation of that module. - When the compiler encounters @import UIKit, it first finds UIKit’s module map in the SDK. - **Module build log** - Explicitly built modules also impact how tasks appear in the build log. - In Xcode 16, explicitly built modules are used for all C and Objective-C code, and can be enabled as a preview for Swift. - **Optimize your build** - Lets go back to ResearchKit and remove the extra variants. - Selecting the Clang modules report shows that there are 2 variants of UIKit and many other modules. - **Wrap up** - title: Deploy machine learning and AI models on-device with Core ML
text: # Deploy machine learning and AI models on-device with Core ML ## ✨ 개요 - 세션 주제: **Deploy machine learning and AI models on-device with Core ML** - 세션 링크: `https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2024/10161/` - 핵심 소개: 세션 소개 및 Transcript를 기반으로 핵심 내용을 정리했습니다. - 왜 중요한지: AI/ML 기능은 모델 성능만이 아니라 통합 방식·지연시간·전력·프라이버시 설계가 성공을 좌우하기 때문입니다. - 언제 쓰는지: 온디바이스 AI 도입, 모델 추론 UX 설계, 성능 최적화 전략 수립 시 특히 유용합니다. - 이 세션에서 특히 봐야 할 포인트 - `Introduction`: Hi, I’m Joshua Newnham, an engineer on the Core ML team. - `Integration`: The machine learning workflow consists of three phases, model training, preparation, and integration. - `MLTensor`: Introducing MLTensor, a new type in Core ML that provides a convenient and efficient way to support this computation. - `Models with state`: In this section, we’ll introduce state and explore how it can be used to reduce the time it takes to generate each word from the language model. ## 🧭 구조 - 세션은 챕터 기준으로 점진적으로 개념/구현/운영 포인트를 쌓는 구조입니다. - 챕터 흐름 요약 - **Introduction** - Hi, I’m Joshua Newnham, an engineer on the Core ML team. - Today, I'm excited to introduce you to some new features in Core ML to help you efficiently deploy and run your machine learning and AI models on-device. - **Integration** - The machine learning workflow consists of three phases, model training, preparation, and integration. - In this video, we’ll focus on integrating and running your machine learning and AI models on-device. - **MLTensor** - Introducing MLTensor, a new type in Core ML that provides a convenient and efficient way to support this computation. - MLTensor offers many common math and transformation operations typical of machine learning frameworks. - **Models with state** - In this section, we’ll introduce state and explore how it can be used to reduce the time it takes to generate each word from the language model. - Let’s begin by first describing what we mean by state. - title: Design considerations for vision and motion
text: # Design considerations for vision and motion ## ✨ 개요 - 세션 주제: **Design considerations for vision and motion** - 세션 링크: `https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2023/10078/` - 핵심 소개: 세션 소개 및 Transcript를 기반으로 핵심 내용을 정리했습니다. - 왜 중요한지: 공간 컴퓨팅은 3D 렌더링·입력·성능·몰입감이 동시에 맞아야 해서 설계 판단 기준이 중요합니다. - 언제 쓰는지: 2D 앱을 visionOS/3D 경험으로 확장하거나 SceneKit→RealityKit 전환을 검토할 때 유용합니다. ## 🧭 구조 - 챕터 정보 없이 Transcript 중심으로 핵심 개념 → 적용 방식 → 마무리 순으로 전개됩니다. ## 🛠️ 세부 API - 세션에서 반복적으로 등장하거나 설계상 중요한 API/개념 - 실전 개발자 관점: API 이름 자체보다 **상태 경계, 에러 처리, 성능 영향, 테스트 전략**까지 함께 봐야 재사용 가능한 패턴이 됩니다. ## 🔍 차이점 - 세션의 핵심은 단순 API 사용법보다, **문제를 어떻게 모델링하고 어떤 레이어에 배치하는지**를 보여주는 데 있습니다. - 같은 기능도 Apple 권장 패턴을 따르면 상태 관리·에러 처리·성능 최적화 포인트가 더 명확해집니다. - 실전 도입은 전체 교체보다 “파일럿 적용 → 패턴 검증 → 공통화” 순서가 리스크를 줄입니다. - 3D/visionOS 세션들은 데모 구현 자체보다 프레임워크 선택(SceneKit vs RealityKit 등)과 구성 경계를 어떻게 잡는지가 장기 유지보수 관점에서 더 중요합니다. ## 🧪 실전 포인트 - 아키텍처: 세션에서 제시한 패턴을 전체 코드베이스에 즉시 적용하기보다, 변동성이 큰 모듈/화면/플로우부터 파일럿 적용 후 표준화하세요. - UX: 몰입감 강화보다 피로도, 입력 예측 가능성, 컨텍스트 유지 설계가 UX 핵심입니다. - 주의사항: 데모 코드는 개념 전달 중심인 경우가 많으므로, 프로덕션 적용 시에는 오류 처리, 취소, 로깅, 관측성(metrics), 롤백 전략을 보강해야 합니다. - 설계 판단 기준: 도입 이점(가독성/성능/안정성/개발속도)과 비용(학습/마이그레이션/테스트/호환성)을 팀 단위로 비교해 우선순위를 정하세요. ## ✅ 핵심 정리 - 이 세션은 **Design considerations for vision and motion**를 단순 기능 소개가 아니라, 실제 제품/서비스 코드에 적용할 때 필요한 설계 판단 관점까지 연결해 이해하는 데 가치가 있습니다. - 특히 실무에서는 “무엇을 도입할까”보다 “어떤 문제에 어떤 경계와 패턴으로 적용할까”를 합의하는 기준 문서로 활용하기 좋습니다. 핵심 메시지 한 문장: 세션의 핵심은 API 사용법 자체보다, 제품 요구사항과 운영 조건에 맞춰 도입 범위와 설계 경계를 판단하는 기준을 만드는 데 있습니다.

text: # Dive deep into volumes and immersive spaces ## ✨ 개요 - 세션 주제: **Dive deep into volumes and immersive spaces** - 세션 링크: `https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2024/10153/` - 핵심 소개: 세션 소개 및 Transcript를 기반으로 핵심 내용을 정리했습니다. - 왜 중요한지: 공간 컴퓨팅은 3D 렌더링·입력·성능·몰입감이 동시에 맞아야 해서 설계 판단 기준이 중요합니다. - 언제 쓰는지: 2D 앱을 visionOS/3D 경험으로 확장하거나 SceneKit→RealityKit 전환을 검토할 때 유용합니다. - 이 세션에서 특히 봐야 할 포인트 - `Introduction`: Hello! - `Volumes`: So let’s get started with a Volume! - `Volumes: Baseplate`: When I create a new volumetric app, or link an existing app against the visionOS 2 SDK, one of the first things to notice is the new baseplate. - `Volumes: Size`: Notice how the baseplate guides me to the resize handle at the corner. ## 🧭 구조 - 세션은 챕터 기준으로 점진적으로 개념/구현/운영 포인트를 쌓는 구조입니다. - 챕터 흐름 요약 - **Introduction** - Hello! - My name is Owen, and I’m a SwiftUI engineer. - **Volumes** - So let’s get started with a Volume! - **Volumes: Baseplate** - When I create a new volumetric app, or link an existing app against the visionOS 2 SDK, one of the first things to notice is the new baseplate. - It appears automatically when looked at, highlighting the bottom edges of the volume. - **Volumes: Size** - Notice how the baseplate guides me to the resize handle at the corner. - But when I try to resize the scene it just springs back to its original size. - **Volumes: Toolbars** - However, the button itself looks a little bit out of place here. - It would fit perfectly in a toolbar. - **Volumes: Ornaments** - Alongside the toolbar, you can now add additional ornaments to a volume. - Ornaments are great for providing extra controls, or more detail about the current content. - **Volumes: Viewpoints** - Each side of the volume is a viewpoint. - As you move around a volume, the window controls and ornaments automatically move to the viewpoint closest to you. - **Volumes: World alignment** - There are also a couple new options options to control how volumes present themselves within the world. - The first one of these is world alignment. - **Volumes: Dynamic scale** - Also, volumes can now be made dynamic scale. - Windows in visionOS change their scale scale as they get moved around in the world. - **Intermezzo** - This is a great start. - We have a very fun app in a volume. - 실전 해석: 초반 챕터는 개념 정의, 중반은 구성/API 적용, 후반은 운영/확장 포인트로 읽으면 팀 공유 자료로 활용하기 좋습니다. ## 🛠️ 세부 API - text: # Elevate your tab and sidebar experience in iPadOS ## ✨ 개요 - 세션 주제: **Elevate your tab and sidebar experience in iPadOS** - 세션 링크: `https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2024/10147/` - 핵심 소개: 세션 소개 및 Transcript를 기반으로 핵심 내용을 정리했습니다. - 왜 중요한지: 기능 소개를 실제 제품 설계/운영 판단으로 연결할 때 비로소 세션의 가치가 커지기 때문입니다. - 언제 쓰는지: 도입 검토 단계에서 우선순위·범위·리스크를 판단할 때 활용도가 높습니다. - 이 세션에서 특히 봐야 할 포인트 - `Introduction`: Hi there, welcome to "Elevate your tab and sidebar experience in iPadOS." My name is Andy, and I'm a UIKit engineer. - `Tab bar and sidebar refresh`: tab bars are refreshed with a new compact look that reduces the amount of unused vertical and horizontal space, bringing more content to the forefront. - `Tab bar and sidebar features`: When you compile with the iPadOS 18 SDK, your existing tab bar apps will be updated to the new look without any code changes. - `Tab bar SwiftUI updates`: New in iOS 18, TabView has a new syntax in SwiftUI to make it easier to catch common errors at build time. ## 🧭 구조 - 세션은 챕터 기준으로 점진적으로 개념/구현/운영 포인트를 쌓는 구조입니다. - 챕터 흐름 요약 - **Introduction** - Hi there, welcome to "Elevate your tab and sidebar experience in iPadOS." My name is Andy, and I'm a UIKit engineer. - In this video, I'll guide you through enhancements to the tab bar and sidebar that will elevate your app and help you to put content at the forefront. - **Tab bar and sidebar refresh** - tab bars are refreshed with a new compact look that reduces the amount of unused vertical and horizontal space, bringing more content to the forefront. - On iPadOS 17 and earlier, sidebars were constructed using split views with an outline view in its leading column. - **Tab bar and sidebar features** - I'll start with tab bars and sidebars. - When you compile with the iPadOS 18 SDK, your existing tab bar apps will be updated to the new look without any code changes. - **Tab bar SwiftUI updates** - New in iOS 18, TabView has a new syntax in SwiftUI to make it easier to catch common errors at build time. - You now declare a Tab struct with a title, image, and its content view. - **Tab bar UIKit updates** - New in iOS 18, UIKit has new API to better describe your app hierarchy to UITabBarController. - Create UITab to represent each top-level section of the app, and assign them to the tabs property on tabBarController. - **Search tab** - Search is a common feature in all apps and is immediately recognizable with its magnifying glass symbol. - Using the search role Tab in SwiftUI or UISearchTab in UIKit, the system will configure a tab with a default title, image, and pinned placement. - **Enable sidebar with TabView in SwiftUI** - To enable the sidebar with TabView in SwiftUI: First, set the tabViewStyle to be sidebarAdaptable. - Next, use TabSection to represent a group in the sidebar. - **Enable sidebar with UITabBarController in UIKit** - To enable the sidebar with UITabBarController in UIKit Set the tabBarController's mode to tabSidebar. - Similar to TabSections, use UITabGroup to represent a collection of child tabs that belong to a single group. - **Sidebar actions** - You can also add actions to sections in the sidebar to provide conveniences for common tasks, like creating a new Station in Podcasts. - Tabs are also drop destinations. - **Drop destinations on Tabs in SwiftUI** - To support drop destinations on Tabs in SwiftUI use the dropDestination modifier on the Tab with the receiver type. - 실전 해석: 초반 챕터는 개념 정의, 중반은 구성/API 적용, 후반은 운영/확장 포인트로 읽으면 팀 공유 자료로 활용하기 좋습니다. ## 🛠️ 세부 API - text: # Enhance the immersion of media viewing in custom environments ## ✨ 개요 - 세션 주제: **Enhance the immersion of media viewing in custom environments** - 세션 링크: `https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2024/10115/` - **Immersive environment picker** - Now that you have learned how to enhance the immersion of media playback in a custom environment, you can take advantage of the Immersive Environment Picker to make your custom environment appear in the same list as the visionOS system environments. - title: Explore game input in visionOS
text: # Explore game input in visionOS ## ✨ 개요 - 세션 주제: **Explore game input in visionOS** - 세션 링크: `https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2024/10094/` - 핵심 소개: 세션 소개 및 Transcript를 기반으로 핵심 내용을 정리했습니다. - 왜 중요한지: 공간 컴퓨팅은 3D 렌더링·입력·성능·몰입감이 동시에 맞아야 해서 설계 판단 기준이 중요합니다. - 언제 쓰는지: 2D 앱을 visionOS/3D 경험으로 확장하거나 SceneKit→RealityKit 전환을 검토할 때 유용합니다. - 이 세션에서 특히 봐야 할 포인트 - `Introduction`: Hi, I'm Charlyn, from the Technology Evangelism team. - `Design around gestures`: Input designed around visionOS gestures can be either direct or indirect. - `System gestures`: Before you decide, keep in mind there are some real advantages to using the built-in system gestures. - `Combination gestures`: System gestures give you a ton of choices right out of the box. ## 🧭 구조 - 세션은 챕터 기준으로 점진적으로 개념/구현/운영 포인트를 쌓는 구조입니다. - 챕터 흐름 요약 - **Introduction** - Hi, I'm Charlyn, from the Technology Evangelism team. - Today I'm talking about what goes into great game input in visionOS. - **Design around gestures** - Input designed around visionOS gestures can be either direct or indirect. - Direct input means you're reaching out and handling a virtual object directly. - **System gestures** - Before you decide, keep in mind there are some real advantages to using the built-in system gestures. - For one thing, players already know exactly how to use the system gestures, because they're already using them to navigate all the other apps and games on the platform. - **Combination gestures** - System gestures give you a ton of choices right out of the box. - If you need even more flexibility, you can combine the system gestures together to make something unique. - **Custom gestures** - But if you do need to round out your arsenal of input, you can define your own custom gestures. - Any custom gestures you create for your game need to be easy for players to learn, and easy for them to remember. - **Physical controllers** - But in some cases, you may want to add support for one of the physical input devices available in visionOS. - visionOS supports all of the same game controllers that iOS and macOS support, including the Xbox Series X, and the Sony Playstation DualSense controllers. - title: Explore the Swift on Server ecosystem
text: # Explore the Swift on Server ecosystem ## ✨ 개요 - 세션 주제: **Explore the Swift on Server ecosystem** - 세션 링크: `https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2024/10216/` - 핵심 소개: 세션 소개 및 Transcript를 기반으로 핵심 내용을 정리했습니다. - 왜 중요한지: 배포/운영 자동화는 개발 속도와 운영 리스크를 동시에 줄여 팀 생산성에 직접 영향을 주기 때문입니다. - 언제 쓰는지: CI/CD 고도화, TestFlight 운영 자동화, App Store 운영 자동화 설계 시 유용합니다. - 이 세션에서 특히 봐야 할 포인트 - `Introduction`: Hi, I'm Franz from the Swift on Server Team at Apple. - `Agenda`: First, we will talk about why Swift is such a great language for developing server applications. - `Meet Swift on Server`: Let's get started on what makes Swift great for server applications. - `Build a service`: Now, let's use some of the popular packages from the server ecosystem to build a service. ## 🧭 구조 - 세션은 챕터 기준으로 점진적으로 개념/구현/운영 포인트를 쌓는 구조입니다. - 챕터 흐름 요약 - **Introduction** - Hi, I'm Franz from the Swift on Server Team at Apple. - Today, we are going to explore the Swift on Server ecosystem. - **Agenda** - First, we will talk about why Swift is such a great language for developing server applications. - Then we are going to build a service with some popular packages from the ecosystem. - **Meet Swift on Server** - Let's get started on what makes Swift great for server applications. - In fact, the Swift Server workgroup was founded in 2016, just one year after the open sourcing of Swift. - **Build a service** - Now, let's use some of the popular packages from the server ecosystem to build a service. - The package depends on the OpenAPI generator and uses Vapor as the server transport for OpenAPI. - **Swift OpenAPI generator** - and generate code for servers and clients. - If you are new or want to review OpenAPI feel free to watch "Meet Swift OpenAPI Generator" from last year. - **Database drivers** - we want to dynamically add new events and persist them in a database, so let's take a look at database drivers. - There are many different database drivers in the open source ecosystem for databases like PostgreSQL, MySQL, Cassandra, MongoDB and many more. - **Observability** - In cases like this, adding additional observability to your service helps troubleshooting. - Observability consists of three pillars logging, metrics and tracing. - **Explore the ecosystem** - of the Swift on Server ecosystem that you can use to build a service. - If you are interested in finding more libraries go to the swift.org packages section and explore the server category. - **Wrap up** - I hope this session excited you about the Swift on Server ecosystem. - We talked about why Swift is such a great language for server applications and how it is powering a lot of critical features across Apple's cloud services. - **Learn about controls** - Controls are a new way to extend your app’s functionality into system spaces including Control Center, the Lock Screen, and the Action button, and they’re created using WidgetKit. - `Scaled text`: First, let’s explore how to scale text. - `Dynamic layouts`: Using text styles with the system font is a great way to get started with Dynamic Type. - `Images and symbols`: Along with layout, images and symbols that appear with text content may need specific adjustments when using larger text. ## 🧭 구조 - 세션은 챕터 기준으로 점진적으로 개념/구현/운영 포인트를 쌓는 구조입니다. - 챕터 흐름 요약 - **Introduction** - Hi, my name is Gaeth, and I’m an engineer on the Accessibility team. - By default, there are 7 available text sizes to chose from. - **Scaled text** - First, let’s explore how to scale text. - A great experience with Dynamic Type in your app starts with making use of built-in text styles. - **Dynamic layouts** - Using text styles with the system font is a great way to get started with Dynamic Type. - As you refine your app’s experience with larger text, you may also consider adapting the layout of content for the best experience. - **Images and symbols** - Along with layout, images and symbols that appear with text content may need specific adjustments when using larger text. - When working with images and icons in large text, you'll want to achieve a balance between scaling an icon for larger text while keeping it from taking too much space from the text. - **Large content viewer** - title: Go further with Swift Testing
text: # Go further with Swift Testing ## ✨ 개요 - 세션 주제: **Go further with Swift Testing** - 세션 링크: `https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2024/10195/` - 핵심 소개: 세션 소개 및 Transcript를 기반으로 핵심 내용을 정리했습니다. - 왜 중요한지: 기능 소개를 실제 제품 설계/운영 판단으로 연결할 때 비로소 세션의 가치가 커지기 때문입니다. - 언제 쓰는지: 도입 검토 단계에서 우선순위·범위·리스크를 판단할 때 활용도가 높습니다. - 이 세션에서 특히 봐야 할 포인트 - `Introduction`: Hi I’m Jonathan and I’m part of the Swift Testing team. - `Why we write tests`: It helps surface issues before your code reaches your users and gives you confidence that you’re shipping a quality product. - `Challenges in testing`: Tests document and enforce the behavior of your code. - `Writing expressive code`: Readable tests are easier to work with, and make test failures more understandable especially as your code gets more and more complex. ## 🧭 구조 - 세션은 챕터 기준으로 점진적으로 개념/구현/운영 포인트를 쌓는 구조입니다. - 챕터 흐름 요약 - **Introduction** - Hi I’m Jonathan and I’m part of the Swift Testing team. - My colleague Dorothy and I, are here to walk you through some of the powerful features in Swift Testing that will elevate your test development to the next level. - **Why we write tests** - It helps surface issues before your code reaches your users and gives you confidence that you’re shipping a quality product. - However, you may run into challenges as you maintain your project's ever-growing collection of tests. - **Challenges in testing** - Tests document and enforce the behavior of your code. - The more complex your code gets, the more critical it is that your tests are easy to read and understand. - **Writing expressive code** - Readable tests are easier to work with, and make test failures more understandable especially as your code gets more and more complex. - Swift Testing includes several features that can help you write clear, expressive tests. - **Expectations** - Expectations are how you validate that your code is behaving as expected in Swift Testing. - Now this test will fail if no error is thrown, or, if any error is thrown that isn't an instance of BrewingError. - **Required expectations** - Stuart introduced the concept of required expectations. - As a quick reminder, any regular expectation, including throwing ones, can be made into a required expectation. - **Tests with known issues** - Next, let’s go over how to document known errors in your test using the withKnownIssue function. - Triaging test failures is a time-consuming process. - **Custom test descriptions** - In a perfect world, all of your tests pass all of the time and the ice cream machine is always working, of course. - In the real world, tests do fail. - **Parameterized testing** - As we mentioned earlier, one of the challenges in preserving your code’s quality is covering all its edge cases: those bits of complex functionality that rarely happen in your day to day testing. - It’s good practice to run your tests under various conditions to ensure you catch edge cases, but this previously took lots of time and writing a separate test for every possible variation is a maintenance nightmare. - `Updates to offers`: We have a lot of enhancements for subscription offer StoreKit APIs, including a new offer member in Transaction and RenewalInfo, and new support for Offer Codes in macOS. - `Introducing win-back offers`: This year, we have a new offer type to re-gain previous subscribers. - `Configure win-back offers`: To begin, let's take a closer look at win-back offers. ## 🧭 구조 - 세션은 챕터 기준으로 점진적으로 개념/구현/운영 포인트를 쌓는 구조입니다. - 챕터 흐름 요약 - **Introduction** - Hello, and welcome to Implement App Store Offers. - I'm Xiaolan, an engineer from App Store Connect. - **Updates to offers** - We have a lot of enhancements for subscription offer StoreKit APIs, including a new offer member in Transaction and RenewalInfo, and new support for Offer Codes in macOS. - text: # Meet Swift Testing ## ✨ 개요 - 세션 주제: **Meet Swift Testing** - 세션 링크: `https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2024/10179/` - 핵심 소개: 세션 소개 및 Transcript를 기반으로 핵심 내용을 정리했습니다. - 왜 중요한지: 기능 소개를 실제 제품 설계/운영 판단으로 연결할 때 비로소 세션의 가치가 커지기 때문입니다. - 언제 쓰는지: 도입 검토 단계에서 우선순위·범위·리스크를 판단할 때 활용도가 높습니다. - 이 세션에서 특히 봐야 할 포인트 - `Introduction`: Hi! - `Agenda`: In this session we’ll start by talking about the building blocks of Swift Testing, the core concepts you need to know. - `Building blocks`: Let’s get started by taking a tour of the building blocks of Swift Testing. - `Building blocks: @Test functions`: Then, we’ll write a global function. ## 🧭 구조 - 세션은 챕터 기준으로 점진적으로 개념/구현/운영 포인트를 쌓는 구조입니다. - 챕터 흐름 요약 - **Introduction** - Hi! - I’m Stuart Montgomery, and I’m thrilled to introduce Swift Testing to you. - **Agenda** - In this session we’ll start by talking about the building blocks of Swift Testing, the core concepts you need to know. - Then, we’ll discuss several common workflows, including ways to customize tests or repeat them with different arguments. - **Building blocks** - Let’s get started by taking a tour of the building blocks of Swift Testing. - If you’ve never written tests for your app before, the first step is to add a test bundle target to your project. - **Building blocks: @Test functions** - Then, we’ll write a global function. - And we’ll add the @Test attribute to it. - **Building blocks: Expectations (#expect and #require)** - Next, we'll use the #expect macro to check that the video metadata are correct. - The #expect macro performs an expectation, and this is the second building block of Swift Testing. - **Building blocks: Traits** - Before we commit this test to the project, let’s make its purpose more clear. - We can do that by passing a custom display name in the @Test attribute. - **Building blocks: @Suite types** - We've finished writing our first test, and now let’s add a second one to validate another aspect of the Video type. - This time, let’s use the built-in test snippet in Xcode 16 to quickly add an empty test function. - **Building blocks: Designed for Swift** - So let’s review the building blocks. - They were designed to feel right at home in Swift, in several ways: Test functions integrate seamlessly with Swift concurrency by supporting async/await and actor isolation. - **Common workflows** - Let’s now apply those building blocks to some common problems in testing and discuss workflows for addressing them. - We’ll discuss controlling when tests run; associating tests which have things in common; and repeating tests more than once with different arguments each time. - `Contact Access Button`: Now that you understand the basics of accessing contacts, I'm excited to go over the best way for your app to handle limited access, the Contact Access Button! - `Accessing contacts`: In addition to the button, Contacts framework has 3 other ways that you can access contact data I’ll go over how they work, and what limited access means when using them. ## 🧭 구조 - `The Coffee Tracker app`: When we first introduced Swift concurrency at WWDC 2021, - `Review the refactor from WWDC21`: I walked you through how to adopt Swift’s new concurrency model in this app. - `Swift 6 and data-race safety`: The compiler will prevent this kind of accidental sharing of state between tasks and actors, allowing you to carry out refactoring, or add new functionality to your app, without... ## 🧭 구조 - We’ll see how Swift 6 helps protect you against possible race conditions, and look at some techniques for introducing this change gradually into your app, as well as how to deal with interactions with frameworks that aren’t yet aware of Swift’s concurrency guarantees. - **The Coffee Tracker app** - that tracks coffee consumption throughout the day, as well as a complication to show your current caffeine level on a watch face. - When we first introduced Swift concurrency at WWDC 2021, - **Review the refactor from WWDC21** - I walked you through how to adopt Swift’s new concurrency model in this app. - The actors communicated between each other using thread-safe value types, using Swift’s async/await feature. - **Swift 6 and data-race safety** - The compiler will prevent this kind of accidental sharing of state between tasks and actors, allowing you to carry out refactoring, or add new functionality to your app, without worrying that you’re introducing new concurrency bugs. - The Swift 6 language mode is opting for both existing and new projects. - **Swift 6 migration in practice** - We’re going to take our CoffeeTracker application, and enable Swift’s data isolation. - We’ll do this step-by-step, and look at some of the guidance the compiler gives us, about where we need to make changes to allow Swift to guarantee that CoffeeTracker is free of any data races. - **The strategy** - where we migrate each one of the targets in our code. - This is a per-module setting that leaves your project in Swift 5 mode, but enables warnings for all the code that would fail with Swift 6’s enforced data isolation. - **Adopting concurrency features** - What does complete checking enable? - If you’ve already been using Swift Concurrency in your app, you’ve probably seen warnings or errors from the Swift compiler about concurrency issues that came up as you adopted Swift’s concurrency features. - **Enabling complete checking in the watch extension** - and in my app, I have two key targets, the WatchKit extension, where my UI layer lives, and CoffeeKit, a framework where the business logic for tracking the caffeine and saving it to HealthKit lives. - Or maybe it’s a framework or package module that will get updated to Swift 6, just hasn’t been yet. - **Shared mutable state in global variables** - We see a logger instance declared as a global variable. - Global variables are a source of shared mutable state, every bit of code in your program, no matter what thread it runs on, is able to read and write to this same variable. - **Shared mutable state in global instances and functions** - 같은 기능도 Apple 권장 패턴을 따르면 상태 관리·에러 처리·성능 최적화 포인트가 더 명확해집니다. - 실전 도입은 전체 교체보다 “파일럿 적용 → 패턴 검증 → 공통화” 순서가 리스크를 줄입니다. ## 🧪 실전 포인트 - 아키텍처: 세션에서 제시한 패턴을 전체 코드베이스에 즉시 적용하기보다, 변동성이 큰 모듈/화면/플로우부터 파일럿 적용 후 표준화하세요. - UX: 정확도뿐 아니라 응답속도, 실패 처리, 사용자 신뢰 형성이 UX를 결정합니다. - 주의사항: 데모 코드는 개념 전달 중심인 경우가 많으므로, 프로덕션 적용 시에는 오류 처리, 취소, 로깅, 관측성(metrics), 롤백 전략을 보강해야 합니다. - 설계 판단 기준: 도입 이점(가독성/성능/안정성/개발속도)과 비용(학습/마이그레이션/테스트/호환성)을 팀 단위로 비교해 우선순위를 정하세요. ## ✅ 핵심 정리 - 이 세션은 **Optimize machine learning for Metal apps**를 단순 기능 소개가 아니라, 실제 제품/서비스 코드에 적용할 때 필요한 설계 판단 관점까지 연결해 이해하는 데 가치가 있습니다. - 특히 실무에서는 “무엇을 도입할까”보다 “어떤 문제에 어떤 경계와 패턴으로 적용할까”를 합의하는 기준 문서로 활용하기 좋습니다. 핵심 메시지 한 문장: 세션의 핵심은 API 사용법 자체보다, 제품 요구사항과 운영 조건에 맞춰 도입 범위와 설계 경계를 판단하는 기준을 만드는 데 있습니다.

text: # Optimize your 3D assets for spatial computing ## ✨ 개요 - 세션 주제: **Optimize your 3D assets for spatial computing** - 세션 링크: `https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2024/10186/` - 핵심 소개: 세션 소개 및 Transcript를 기반으로 핵심 내용을 정리했습니다. - 왜 중요한지: 공간 컴퓨팅은 3D 렌더링·입력·성능·몰입감이 동시에 맞아야 해서 설계 판단 기준이 중요합니다. - 언제 쓰는지: 2D 앱을 visionOS/3D 경험으로 확장하거나 SceneKit→RealityKit 전환을 검토할 때 유용합니다. - 이 세션에서 특히 봐야 할 포인트 - `Introduction`: Hi I’m Scott Wade. - `Before you begin`: Let’s get started with some preliminary aspects to keep in mind. - `Polygon count`: As a general guideline, we recommend no more than 500 thousand triangles for an immersive scene, with 250 thousand for applications in the shared space. - `Export from DCCs`: Next you may be asking what apps you can use to create and edit content. ## 🧭 구조 - 세션은 챕터 기준으로 점진적으로 개념/구현/운영 포인트를 쌓는 구조입니다. - 챕터 흐름 요약 - **Introduction** - Hi I’m Scott Wade. - Welcome to the session “Optimize Your 3D Assets for Spatial Computing”. - **Before you begin** - Let’s get started with some preliminary aspects to keep in mind. - Before you start creating assets the most important thing to consider, is how your content is going to be viewed. - **Polygon count** - The polygon count of your scene, measured in triangles, is a key performance metric to be aware of. - As a general guideline, we recommend no more than 500 thousand triangles for an immersive scene, with 250 thousand for applications in the shared space. - **Export from DCCs** - Next you may be asking what apps you can use to create and edit content. - Luckily you have lots of options because the most important thing is being able to save your work out in USD format. - **Efficient texture use** - and see how we can make them more efficient. - If you need a primer on setting up materials in Shader Graph, I highly recommend you to check out: “Explore materials in Reality Composer Pro” session from 2023. - **Optimizing materials** - and discuss optimized material and shader choices. - I’ve brought in the scene we saw earlier to go with my individual assets. - **Sky dome setup** - With our scene in place now we need a sky dome. - Otherwise our audience will see their passthrough environment beyond the edge of our scene. - **Image-based lighting** - With our skybox in place the scene is really coming together. - But if we take a look at our PBR assets from before you may notice they don’t quite look right. - text: # Port advanced games to Apple platforms ## ✨ 개요 - 세션 주제: **Port advanced games to Apple platforms** - 세션 링크: `https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2024/10089/` - 핵심 소개: 세션 소개 및 Transcript를 기반으로 핵심 내용을 정리했습니다. - `Port your game`: if you already have your game running on other platforms, the evaluation environment for Windows games allows you to see your game running on Apple silicon before you even start... - 세션 기반 체크포인트 - `Wrap-up`: to see if you can use environment constraints to make your app more secure. ## ✅ 핵심 정리 - 이 세션은 **Protect your Mac app with environment constraints**를 단순 기능 소개가 아니라, 실제 제품/서비스 코드에 적용할 때 필요한 설계 판단 관점까지 연결해 이해하는 데 가치가 있습니다. - 특히 실무에서는 “무엇을 도입할까”보다 “어떤 문제에 어떤 경계와 패턴으로 적용할까”를 합의하는 기준 문서로 활용하기 좋습니다. 핵심 메시지 한 문장: 세션의 핵심은 API 사용법 자체보다, 제품 요구사항과 운영 조건에 맞춰 도입 범위와 설계 경계를 판단하는 기준을 만드는 데 있습니다.

왜 중요한지: 기능 소개를 실제 제품 설계/운영 판단으로 연결할 때 비로소 세션의 가치가 커지기 때문입니다. - 언제 쓰는지: 도입 검토 단계에서 우선순위·범위·리스크를 판단할 때 활용도가 높습니다. - 이 세션에서 특히 봐야 할 포인트 - `Welcome`: ♪ ♪ Shawn: Hi, I am Shawn. - `Discover the benefits of L4S`: A busy network can be especially challenging for apps that depend on features like real-time audio and video. - `Learn how L4S works`: Now, let's take a look at how L4S works. - `Prepare your app`: Using networking APIs in URLSession and Network framework is the best way to adopt L4S in your app. ## 🧭 구조 - 세션은 챕터 기준으로 점진적으로 개념/구현/운영 포인트를 쌓는 구조입니다. - 챕터 흐름 요약 - **Welcome** - ♪ ♪ Shawn: Hi, I am Shawn. - Today, we are going to talk about reducing network delays in your app with L4S. - **Discover the benefits of L4S** - A busy network can be especially challenging for apps that depend on features like real-time audio and video. - When the network is used by many devices at once, it can often cause high latency and packet loss in these types of apps. - **Learn how L4S works** - Now, let's take a look at how L4S works. - We see such remarkable improvements, because L4S reduces queueing and packet loss. - **Prepare your app** - Using networking APIs in URLSession and Network framework is the best way to adopt L4S in your app. - If your app uses HTTP/3 or QUIC within these frameworks, L4S support is automatically built in. - **Set up your server** - Now we have covered how to prepare your app for L4S, let's explore how to set up your server. - If your app uses QUIC, your server's implementation of QUIC also needs to support L4S and ECN markings. - **Configure test network and devices** - Now that we have covered how your app and server can be set up for L4S, let's explore how to set up an L4S network to test your app. - First, let's review what makes a network L4S-capable. - 핵심 소개: 세션 소개 및 Transcript를 기반으로 핵심 내용을 정리했습니다. - 왜 중요한지: 기능 소개를 실제 제품 설계/운영 판단으로 연결할 때 비로소 세션의 가치가 커지기 때문입니다. - 언제 쓰는지: 도입 검토 단계에서 우선순위·범위·리스크를 판단할 때 활용도가 높습니다. - 이 세션에서 특히 봐야 할 포인트 - `Introduction`: Hello, My name is Felipe, and I am an engineer on the debugging technologies team at Apple. - `Agenda`: We will start by defining a debugging model to guide us when using the debugger. - `Debugging as a search problem`: When debugging an issue with a program, we are typically provided with a point in time where the program is doing something wrong. - `Crashlogs & starting the program`: Most debugging sessions start by compiling the code and running the application under the debugger. ## 🧭 구조 - 세션은 챕터 기준으로 점진적으로 개념/구현/운영 포인트를 쌓는 구조입니다. - 챕터 흐름 요약 - **Introduction** - Hello, My name is Felipe, and I am an engineer on the debugging technologies team at Apple. - In this talk, we are going to cover debugging techniques allowing you to explore code with ease and find bugs faster. - **Agenda** - We will start by defining a debugging model to guide us when using the debugger. - Then, we will cover a different way of debugging using crashlogs. - **Debugging as a search problem** - When debugging an issue with a program, we are typically provided with a point in time where the program is doing something wrong. - This could be a crash, an incorrect value being displayed, or even the program hanging. - **Crashlogs & starting the program** - Most debugging sessions start by compiling the code and running the application under the debugger. - Very often, all we need to do is hit the start button in Xcode or launch lldb through the command line using the target executable and its arguments. - **Breakpoints** - Destination video is built with SwiftUI, which I am trying to learn more about, so I have prototyped a feature where users can add videos to a "Watch Later" list. - The first location on the list is where the program is currently stopped: the call to Button's constructor on line 70. - **Breakpoint actions** - Pausing the application is an important part of the debugging cycle, but we can improve the debugging experience by combining it with program inspection. - As an example, let’s try to learn how UI elements interact with the program, and focus on that first breakpoint, the one calling the Button constructor. - **Help command** - Lldb provides detailed description of all of its commands by using the help command. - You can also get help for any option of a specific command. - **High-firing breakpoints** - When debugging, we often create a breakpoint that is triggered many times, but we are only interested in a subset of those. - A common example is when a breakpoint is placed inside a loop and, instead of breaking on every iteration, we only want to break when certain events happen. - **The p command** - starting the program and breaking at interesting locations. - But we only glanced at the main tool for inspecting program state: the `p` command. - **@DebugDescription macro** - Most variables we’ve inspected so far were fairly simple. - However, types that contain too much data are cumbersome to inspect during a debugging session, and they may benefit from having a short description in the variable viewer or the `p` command. - 실전 해석: 초반 챕터는 개념 정의, 중반은 구성/API 적용, 후반은 운영/확장 포인트로 읽으면 팀 공유 자료로 활용하기 좋습니다. ## 🛠️ 세부 API - 세션에서 반복적으로 등장하거나 설계상 중요한 API/개념 - **JSON** - 왜 중요한지: 이 세션의 핵심 구현 전략 또는 설계 판단 포인트를 구성하는 요소입니다. - 언제 쓰는지: 실제 기능 구현/리팩터링/마이그레이션 설계 시 우선 검토 대상입니다. - **WatchLaterItem** - 왜 중요한지: 이 세션의 핵심 구현 전략 또는 설계 판단 포인트를 구성하는 요소입니다. - 언제 쓰는지: 실제 기능 구현/리팩터링/마이그레이션 설계 시 우선 검토 대상입니다. - 실전 개발자 관점: API 이름 자체보다 **상태 경계, 에러 처리, 성능 영향, 테스트 전략**까지 함께 봐야 재사용 가능한 패턴이 됩니다. ## 🔍 차이점 - 세션의 핵심은 단순 API 사용법보다, **문제를 어떻게 모델링하고 어떤 레이어에 배치하는지**를 보여주는 데 있습니다. - 같은 기능도 Apple 권장 패턴을 따르면 상태 관리·에러 처리·성능 최적화 포인트가 더 명확해집니다. - 실전 도입은 전체 교체보다 “파일럿 적용 → 패턴 검증 → 공통화” 순서가 리스크를 줄입니다. ## 🧪 실전 포인트 - 아키텍처: 세션에서 제시한 패턴을 전체 코드베이스에 즉시 적용하기보다, 변동성이 큰 모듈/화면/플로우부터 파일럿 적용 후 표준화하세요. - UX: 기술 선택은 성능·안정성·예측 가능성을 통해 사용자 경험에 직접 반영됩니다. - 주의사항: 데모 코드는 개념 전달 중심인 경우가 많으므로, 프로덕션 적용 시에는 오류 처리, 취소, 로깅, 관측성(metrics), 롤백 전략을 보강해야 합니다. - 설계 판단 기준: 도입 이점(가독성/성능/안정성/개발속도)과 비용(학습/마이그레이션/테스트/호환성)을 팀 단위로 비교해 우선순위를 정하세요. - 세션 기반 체크포인트 - `Breakpoints`: Destination video is built with SwiftUI, which I am trying to learn more about, so I have prototyped a feature where users can add videos to a "Watch Later" list. - `Breakpoint actions`: Pausing the application is an important part of the debugging cycle, but we can improve the debugging experience by combining it with program inspection. ## ✅ 핵심 정리 - 이 세션은 **Run, Break, Inspect: Explore effective debugging in LLDB**를 단순 기능 소개가 아니라, 실제 제품/서비스 코드에 적용할 때 필요한 설계 판단 관점까지 연결해 이해하는 데 가치가 있습니다. - 특히 실무에서는 “무엇을 도입할까”보다 “어떤 문제에 어떤 경계와 패턴으로 적용할까”를 합의하는 기준 문서로 활용하기 좋습니다. 핵심 메시지 한 문장: 세션의 핵심은 API 사용법 자체보다, 제품 요구사항과 운영 조건에 맞춰 도입 범위와 설계 경계를 판단하는 기준을 만드는 데 있습니다.

title: Share files with SharePlay
text: # Share files with SharePlay ## ✨ 개요 - 세션 주제: **Share files with SharePlay** - 세션 링크: `https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2023/10241/` - 핵심 소개: 세션 소개 및 Transcript를 기반으로 핵심 내용을 정리했습니다. - 왜 중요한지: 배포/운영 자동화는 개발 속도와 운영 리스크를 동시에 줄여 팀 생산성에 직접 영향을 주기 때문입니다. - 언제 쓰는지: CI/CD 고도화, TestFlight 운영 자동화, App Store 운영 자동화 설계 시 유용합니다. - 이 세션에서 특히 봐야 할 포인트 - `Transfer attachments`: Let’s talk through our drawing app. - `GroupSessionJournal`: Our main object to familiarize yourself with is the "GroupSessionJournal." This object is new to iOS 17. - `Late joiners`: you may remember this topic: Late joiners. - `Adopt in DrawTogether`: Now that was a lot of information, so let’s jump into the fun part and see the magic at work and walk through how we would adopt the GroupSessionJournal in our DrawTogether app. ## 🧭 구조 - 세션은 챕터 기준으로 점진적으로 개념/구현/운영 포인트를 쌓는 구조입니다. - 챕터 흐름 요약 - **Transfer attachments** - Let’s talk through our drawing app. - We have it so that we can sync drawings between two devices with the GroupSessionMessenger. - **GroupSessionJournal** - Well, let’s dive right in! - Our main object to familiarize yourself with is the "GroupSessionJournal." text: # Streamline sign-in with passkey upgrades and credential managers ## ✨ 개요 - 세션 주제: **Streamline sign-in with passkey upgrades and credential managers** - 세션 링크: `https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2024/10125/` - 핵심 소개: 세션 소개 및 Transcript를 기반으로 핵심 내용을 정리했습니다. - 왜 중요한지: 기능 소개를 실제 제품 설계/운영 판단으로 연결할 때 비로소 세션의 가치가 커지기 때문입니다. - 언제 쓰는지: 도입 검토 단계에서 우선순위·범위·리스크를 판단할 때 활용도가 높습니다. - 이 세션에서 특히 봐야 할 포인트 - `Introduction`: Hi, I’m Garrett. - `Automatic passkey upgrades`: Let’s start with something that’s really exciting, automatic passkey upgrades. - `The passkey journey`: Phishing, and other forms of stolen credential attacks, make up some of the most common forms of account compromise on the internet today. - `Automatic passkey upgrade sequence`: Here’s a sequence diagram of an automatic passkey upgrade. ## 🧭 구조 - 세션은 챕터 기준으로 점진적으로 개념/구현/운영 포인트를 쌓는 구조입니다. - 챕터 흐름 요약 - **Introduction** - Hi, I’m Garrett. - I’m excited to talk about how you can deploy automatic passkey upgrades in your apps and websites, as well as several other new developments for providing a great sign-in experience. - **Automatic passkey upgrades** - Let’s start with something that’s really exciting, automatic passkey upgrades. - Here’s an example of a typical sign-in today. - **The passkey journey** - Phishing, and other forms of stolen credential attacks, make up some of the most common forms of account compromise on the internet today. - The best way to prevent phishing, is to have accounts that don’t have any phishable factors. - **Automatic passkey upgrade sequence** - Here’s a sequence diagram of an automatic passkey upgrade. - Your app makes a request to the system, and the system decides whether it makes sense to create a passkey at this time, returning the new passkey if so. - **Shipping and deploying passkey support** - Shipping passkey support in your apps and on your websites is like developing and deploying any feature, with learning, building, testing, and shipping phases. - But something unique to the passkey journey is that the ultimate goal is two-fold, to make sign-in easier and to improve account security. - **Improvements for credential managers** - Next up, I’ll talk about some of the new features available for credential managers. - Credential managers can of course participate in automatic passkey upgrades. - **The new Passwords app!** - Finally, I’ll talk about the Passwords app, new in macOS Sequoia, iOS 18, and visionOS 2. - In the app, your website’s name and icon are in the spotlight, showing off its personality. - **Updating appearance in the Passwords app** - Here’s an example, of what an account looks like in the Passwords app. - This account has both a passkey and a password. - **One-tap verification code setup** - Finally, for apps and websites that offer time-based verification codes, you can make setting up that code a one-tap experience by offering an otpauth: link in addition to the standard QR code. - This link opens the default verification code app on the system, making it easy to set up codes either on another device or directly on the device you’re already using. - 실전 해석: 초반 챕터는 개념 정의, 중반은 구성/API 적용, 후반은 운영/확장 포인트로 읽으면 팀 공유 자료로 활용하기 좋습니다. ## 🛠️ 세부 API - 세션에서 반복적으로 등장하거나 설계상 중요한 API/개념 - **actor** - 왜 중요한지: 이 세션의 핵심 구현 전략 또는 설계 판단 포인트를 구성하는 요소입니다. - 언제 쓰는지: 실제 기능 구현/리팩터링/마이그레이션 설계 시 우선 검토 대상입니다. - **OpenGraph** - 왜 중요한지: 이 세션의 핵심 구현 전략 또는 설계 판단 포인트를 구성하는 요소입니다. - 언제 쓰는지: 실제 기능 구현/리팩터링/마이그레이션 설계 시 우선 검토 대상입니다. - **SMS** - 왜 중요한지: 이 세션의 핵심 구현 전략 또는 설계 판단 포인트를 구성하는 요소입니다. - 언제 쓰는지: 실제 기능 구현/리팩터링/마이그레이션 설계 시 우선 검토 대상입니다. - **AutoFill** - 왜 중요한지: 이 세션의 핵심 구현 전략 또는 설계 판단 포인트를 구성하는 요소입니다. - 언제 쓰는지: 실제 기능 구현/리팩터링/마이그레이션 설계 시 우선 검토 대상입니다. - **URL** - 왜 중요한지: 이 세션의 핵심 구현 전략 또는 설계 판단 포인트를 구성하는 요소입니다. - 언제 쓰는지: 실제 기능 구현/리팩터링/마이그레이션 설계 시 우선 검토 대상입니다. - **extension** - 왜 중요한지: 이 세션의 핵심 구현 전략 또는 설계 판단 포인트를 구성하는 요소입니다. - 언제 쓰는지: 실제 기능 구현/리팩터링/마이그레이션 설계 시 우선 검토 대상입니다. - 실전 개발자 관점: API 이름 자체보다 **상태 경계, 에러 처리, 성능 영향, 테스트 전략**까지 함께 봐야 재사용 가능한 패턴이 됩니다. ## 🔍 차이점 - 세션의 핵심은 단순 API 사용법보다, **문제를 어떻게 모델링하고 어떤 레이어에 배치하는지**를 보여주는 데 있습니다. - 같은 기능도 Apple 권장 패턴을 따르면 상태 관리·에러 처리·성능 최적화 포인트가 더 명확해집니다. - 실전 도입은 전체 교체보다 “파일럿 적용 → 패턴 검증 → 공통화” 순서가 리스크를 줄입니다. ## 🧪 실전 포인트 - 아키텍처: 세션에서 제시한 패턴을 전체 코드베이스에 즉시 적용하기보다, 변동성이 큰 모듈/화면/플로우부터 파일럿 적용 후 표준화하세요. - UX: 기술 선택은 성능·안정성·예측 가능성을 통해 사용자 경험에 직접 반영됩니다. - 주의사항: 데모 코드는 개념 전달 중심인 경우가 많으므로, 프로덕션 적용 시에는 오류 처리, 취소, 로깅, 관측성(metrics), 롤백 전략을 보강해야 합니다. - 설계 판단 기준: 도입 이점(가독성/성능/안정성/개발속도)과 비용(학습/마이그레이션/테스트/호환성)을 팀 단위로 비교해 우선순위를 정하세요. - 세션 기반 체크포인트 - `Shipping and deploying passkey support`: Shipping passkey support in your apps and on your websites is like developing and deploying any feature, with learning, building, testing, and shipping phases. - `Improvements for credential managers`: Next up, I’ll talk about some of the new features available for credential managers. ## ✅ 핵심 정리 - 이 세션은 **Streamline sign-in with passkey upgrades and credential managers**를 단순 기능 소개가 아니라, 실제 제품/서비스 코드에 적용할 때 필요한 설계 판단 관점까지 연결해 이해하는 데 가치가 있습니다. - 특히 실무에서는 “무엇을 도입할까”보다 “어떤 문제에 어떤 경계와 패턴으로 적용할까”를 합의하는 기준 문서로 활용하기 좋습니다. 핵심 메시지 한 문장: 세션의 핵심은 API 사용법 자체보다, 제품 요구사항과 운영 조건에 맞춰 도입 범위와 설계 경계를 판단하는 기준을 만드는 데 있습니다.

text: # Support real-time ML inference on the CPU ## ✨ 개요 - 세션 주제: **Support real-time ML inference on the CPU** - 세션 링크: `https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2024/10211/` - 핵심 소개: 세션 소개 및 Transcript를 기반으로 핵심 내용을 정리했습니다. - 왜 중요한지: AI/ML 기능은 모델 성능만이 아니라 통합 방식·지연시간·전력·프라이버시 설계가 성공을 좌우하기 때문입니다. - 언제 쓰는지: 온디바이스 AI 도입, 모델 추론 UX 설계, 성능 최적화 전략 수립 시 특히 유용합니다. - 이 세션에서 특히 봐야 할 포인트 - `Introduction`: Hi, my name is Simon Gladman and I work for the Vector & Numerics Group here at Apple. - `Introducing BNNS Graph`: and let’s dive into BNNS Graph. - `Real-time processing`: So, because our new API is ideally suited to real-time use cases. - `Adopting BNNS Graph`: I’m now going to show you how to create an audio unit project that adopts BNNS Graph. ## 🧭 구조 - 세션은 챕터 기준으로 점진적으로 개념/구현/운영 포인트를 쌓는 구조입니다. - 챕터 흐름 요약 - **Introduction** - Hi, my name is Simon Gladman and I work for the Vector & Numerics Group here at Apple. - Today, I’ll be talking about some exciting new functionality in our machine learning library, Basic Neural Network Subroutines or BNNS. - **Introducing BNNS Graph** - and let’s dive into BNNS Graph. - Just before we get started, let me share how BNNS fits into Apple’s overall stack of machine learning frameworks. - **Real-time processing** - So, because our new API is ideally suited to real-time use cases. - I’ll be looking at such a use-case, working with audio by adding BNNS Graph to an AudioUnit. - **Adopting BNNS Graph** - I’m now going to show you how to create an audio unit project that adopts BNNS Graph. - `Vectorized plots`: That's function plotting with Line Plot and Area Plot, where they treat an entire math function as a single entity. - `Best practices`: Now you might be wondering how Vectorized plots and Marks complement each other. ## 🧭 구조 - 세션은 챕터 기준으로 점진적으로 개념/구현/운영 포인트를 쌓는 구조입니다. - 챕터 흐름 요약 - **Introduction** - Hi, I’m Apollo. - Let me tell you about what's new in Swift Charts. - **Function plots** - I've plotted this video to teach you more about each of these exciting new capabilities of Swift Charts. - `App window structure`: Now, I will use new SwiftUI APIs to further tune the windows for my app's content. - `Style window toolbars`: It is created from a WindowGroup with a content view. - `Refine window behaviors`: Next, I will refine the behaviors of the About window. ## 🧭 구조 - 세션은 챕터 기준으로 점진적으로 개념/구현/운영 포인트를 쌓는 구조입니다. - 챕터 흐름 요약 - **Anatomy of a window** - A typical window has a few recognizable components. - At the top of the window, there is a toolbar to host the window controls, the title, and toolbar items. - **App window structure** - Now, I will use new SwiftUI APIs to further tune the windows for my app's content. - There is the main window, which is the primary interface for navigating through video collections. - title: Use CloudKit Console to monitor and optimize database activity
text: # Use CloudKit Console to monitor and optimize database activity ## ✨ 개요 - 세션 주제: **Use CloudKit Console to monitor and optimize database activity** - 세션 링크: `https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2024/10122/` - 핵심 소개: 세션 소개 및 Transcript를 기반으로 핵심 내용을 정리했습니다. - 왜 중요한지: 디자인 시스템/상태 흐름/UI 구조 선택이 화면 완성도와 유지보수성을 크게 좌우하기 때문입니다. - 언제 쓰는지: 디자인 변경 반영, 신규 화면 설계, SwiftUI 리팩터링 시 적용 기준으로 쓰기 좋습니다. - 이 세션에서 특히 봐야 할 포인트 - `Introduction`: Hello, I'm Christopher Ward, and I'm an engineer on the iCloud developer experience team. - `Notifications`: Notifications make it clear when key events happen in your CloudKit containers. - `Telemetry`: Telemetry in the CloudKit Console visualises your app's interactions with your CloudKit containers. - `Logging`: When issues are identified within your app, you need as much detail as possible to resolve the problem. ## 🧭 구조 - 세션은 챕터 기준으로 점진적으로 개념/구현/운영 포인트를 쌓는 구조입니다. - 챕터 흐름 요약 - **Introduction** - Hello, I'm Christopher Ward, and I'm an engineer on the iCloud developer experience team. - The CloudKit Console's Database application is a tool enabling you to inspect data and manage your database schema in your CloudKit Containers. - **Notifications** - Notifications make it clear when key events happen in your CloudKit containers. - They are sent with important contextual information. - **Telemetry** - Telemetry in the CloudKit Console visualises your app's interactions with your CloudKit containers. - You will use Telemetry to understand current CloudKit activity, and observe trends across metrics including requests, errors, latency and bandwidth. - text: # What’s new in AppKit ## ✨ 개요 - 세션 주제: **What’s new in AppKit** - 세션 링크: `https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2024/10124/` - 핵심 소개: 세션 소개 및 Transcript를 기반으로 핵심 내용을 정리했습니다. - 왜 중요한지: 디자인 시스템/상태 흐름/UI 구조 선택이 화면 완성도와 유지보수성을 크게 좌우하기 때문입니다. - 언제 쓰는지: 디자인 변경 반영, 신규 화면 설계, SwiftUI 리팩터링 시 적용 기준으로 쓰기 좋습니다. - 이 세션에서 특히 봐야 할 포인트 - `Introduction`: I’m Matt Zanchelli, an engineer on the AppKit team and this is What’s new in AppKit. - `New macOS features`: With Writing Tools, macOS can now not only help you with spelling & grammar, - `Writing Tools, Genmoji, and Image Playground`: but more sophisticated writing concepts like structure, clarity, and tone. - `Window Tiling`: in macOS Sequoia: Window Tiling. ## 🧭 구조 - 세션은 챕터 기준으로 점진적으로 개념/구현/운영 포인트를 쌓는 구조입니다. - 챕터 흐름 요약 - **Introduction** - Hello! - I’m Matt Zanchelli, an engineer on the AppKit team and this is What’s new in AppKit. - **New macOS features** - With Writing Tools, macOS can now not only help you with spelling & grammar, - **Writing Tools, Genmoji, and Image Playground** - but more sophisticated writing concepts like structure, clarity, and tone. - We’ve worked hard to bring these writing tools system-wide, and your apps get these intelligence features automatically. - **Window Tiling** - in macOS Sequoia: Window Tiling. - I just gotta show it to you now. - **More SwiftUI integrations** - I love using SwiftUI in my Mac apps, as it’s a fantastic way to build user interfaces. - It’s been designed from the beginning to work alongside AppKit, so that it can be adopted incrementally. - **Build menus with SwiftUI** - you can now use SwiftUI menus, too. - This allows you share menu definitions between the parts of your app that use AppKit and the parts that use SwiftUI. - **Get animated with SwiftUI** - In macOS Sequoia, AppKit gets animated with SwiftUI! - You can now use a SwiftUI Animation type to animate NSViews! - **API refinements** - Next, I’ll share some of the fantastic AppKit API refinements. - There’s a new way to open context menus, new capabilities in the text system and SF symbols, a new convenience when saving documents, some new cursors, more control over toolbars, and an exciting new API to assist with text input. - **Context menu refinements** - New in macOS Sequoia, is the ability to use the keyboard to open a context menu for the currently-focused UI element. - People can use this feature to more quickly or comfortably access an app’s functionality. - **Text highlighting** - The next new API refinement I’ll share is Text highlighting. - Highlights can be used to emphasize text with a background color and contrasting foreground color. - 실전 해석: 초반 챕터는 개념 정의, 중반은 구성/API 적용, 후반은 운영/확장 포인트로 읽으면 팀 공유 자료로 활용하기 좋습니다. ## 🛠️ 세부 API - 적용 판단 시에는 신규 API 추가 여부보다 **기존 구현 대체 범위 / 호환성 / 테스트 비용**을 먼저 계산하는 게 중요합니다. - 배포 타깃 OS 비율이 낮다면, feature flag 또는 조건부 적용으로 단계적 도입 전략을 잡는 편이 안전합니다. - 특히 이 세션은 Swift를 단순 앱 개발 언어가 아니라 서버/CLI/패키지까지 포함한 범용 언어로 보여주며, 언어 기능 선택을 시스템 설계 관점으로 끌어올립니다. ## 🧪 실전 포인트 - 아키텍처: 세션에서 제시한 패턴을 전체 코드베이스에 즉시 적용하기보다, 변동성이 큰 모듈/화면/플로우부터 파일럿 적용 후 표준화하세요. - UX: 언어 수준의 선택(값/참조, 에러 모델, 동시성)은 앱의 안정성과 반응성으로 이어집니다. - 주의사항: 데모 코드는 개념 전달 중심인 경우가 많으므로, 프로덕션 적용 시에는 오류 처리, 취소, 로깅, 관측성(metrics), 롤백 전략을 보강해야 합니다. - 설계 판단 기준: 도입 이점(가독성/성능/안정성/개발속도)과 비용(학습/마이그레이션/테스트/호환성)을 팀 단위로 비교해 우선순위를 정하세요. ## ✅ 핵심 정리 - 이 세션은 **What’s new in Background Assets**를 단순 기능 소개가 아니라, 실제 제품/서비스 코드에 적용할 때 필요한 설계 판단 관점까지 연결해 이해하는 데 가치가 있습니다. - 특히 실무에서는 “무엇을 도입할까”보다 “어떤 문제에 어떤 경계와 패턴으로 적용할까”를 합의하는 기준 문서로 활용하기 좋습니다. 핵심 메시지 한 문장: 세션의 핵심은 API 사용법 자체보다, 제품 요구사항과 운영 조건에 맞춰 도입 범위와 설계 경계를 판단하는 기준을 만드는 데 있습니다.

`Composite attributes`: Composite attributes are a new type of attribute. - `Stage your migrations`: As an application evolves, it may become necessary to change the data model. - `Defer your migrations`: that your app may not be able to provide in the foreground. ## 🧭 구조 - 세션은 챕터 기준으로 점진적으로 개념/구현/운영 포인트를 쌓는 구조입니다. - 챕터 흐름 요약 - **Intro** - ♪ ♪ David: Hi, and welcome to “What's New in Core Data.” My name is David Stites, and I'm an engineer on the Core Data team. - In this session, you'll learn about new technologies in Core Data that will help you more quickly and easily design, query, update, and migrate the Core Data data model in your app. - **Composite attributes** - Composite attributes are a new type of attribute. - Composite attributes allow for the encapsulation of complex and custom data types within a single attribute. - **Stage your migrations** - As an application evolves, it may become necessary to change the data model. - Updating the data model requires that those changes are materialized in the underlying storage schema. - **Defer your migrations** - that your app may not be able to provide in the foreground. - The deferred migration API has runtime compatibility all the way back to macOS Big Sur and iOS 14. - **Wrap-up** - There are three great new technologies in Core Data. - Encapsulate your custom data types in a nestable, structured way using composite attributes, perform complex model migrations using staged migration by decomposing your model changes, and turbocharge your app's performance by delaying some migration work using deferred migration. - text: # What’s new in SwiftData ## ✨ 개요 - 세션 주제: **What’s new in SwiftData** - 세션 링크: `https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2024/10137/` - 핵심 소개: 세션 소개 및 Transcript를 기반으로 핵심 내용을 정리했습니다. - 왜 중요한지: AI/ML 기능은 모델 성능만이 아니라 통합 방식·지연시간·전력·프라이버시 설계가 성공을 좌우하기 때문입니다. - 언제 쓰는지: 온디바이스 AI 도입, 모델 추론 UX 설계, 성능 최적화 전략 수립 시 특히 유용합니다. - 이 세션에서 특히 봐야 할 포인트 - `Introduction`: iOS 17 introduced SwiftData — a framework that allows you to model and persist your app’s data in Swift across all of Apple’s platforms. - `Adopt SwiftData`: First, let’s take a quick tour of SwiftData. - `Customize the schema`: The first step was adding the @Model macro and that was just the beginning of how to customize the Schema. - `#Unique macro`: And this year, there is a new schema macro that allows you to construct a compound constraint on persistent models! ## 🧭 구조 - 세션은 챕터 기준으로 점진적으로 개념/구현/운영 포인트를 쌓는 구조입니다. - 챕터 흐름 요약 - **Introduction** - Hello, I am Rishi Verma, and I am an engineer on the SwiftData Team. - iOS 17 introduced SwiftData — a framework that allows you to model and persist your app’s data in Swift across all of Apple’s platforms. - **Adopt SwiftData** - First, let’s take a quick tour of SwiftData. - SwiftData is a framework that makes it easy to build your app’s model layer and persist it across launches of your app. - **Customize the schema** - The first step was adding the @Model macro and that was just the beginning of how to customize the Schema. - By simply decorating all of my persistable classes with the macro, the Trip class and related models will have their stored properties persisted. - **#Unique macro** - And this year, there is a new schema macro that allows you to construct a compound constraint on persistent models! - You can use the new #Unique macro to tell SwiftData which combinations of your model’s properties must always remain unique in the model data. - **History API** - And because these #Unique properties help ensure these @Models are not duplicated, they also represent the identity of this model. - You can also use the @Attribute macro to decorate these properties with preserveValueOnDeletion. - **Tailor a model container** - Tailoring the model container allows an app to fine tune its data location and how it is used throughout the app. - The modelContainer modifier is the easiest way to get started with SwiftData. - **Custom data stores** - In iOS 18, SwiftData lets you customize your modelContainer even further with fully custom data stores. - The default data store provides a robust persistence backend supporting all of SwiftData’s features. - **Xcode previews** - You can also create custom containers for use with Xcode previews. - Previews are the perfect companion when developing your app with SwiftUI, and work great with SwiftData. - **Customize queries** - Finally, let’s talk about creating rich and optimized queries for SwiftData. - Query drives your SwiftUI Views with an array of Models that can be sorted and filtered with ease, and it automatically reacts to changes made to the ModelContainer! - **#Expression macro** - New in iOS 18 is the ability to use Foundation’s new #Expression macro to build complex predicates easily! - Expressions allow for reference values that do not produce true or false but instead allow for arbitrary types. - 언제 쓰는지: 디자인 변경 반영, 신규 화면 설계, SwiftUI 리팩터링 시 적용 기준으로 쓰기 좋습니다. - 이 세션에서 특히 봐야 할 포인트 - `Introduction`: Hi, and thanks for tuning in! - `Fresh apps`: That’s a lot to cover, so let’s dive right in. - `Fresh apps: TabView`: It’s primarily a side bar driven app, and in iOS 18.0, the sidebar has become a lot more flexible. - `Fresh apps: Presentation sizing`: Sheet presentation sizing is now unified and simplified across platforms. ## 🧭 구조 - 세션은 챕터 기준으로 점진적으로 개념/구현/운영 포인트를 쌓는 구조입니다. - 챕터 흐름 요약 - **Introduction** - Hi, and thanks for tuning in! - I’m Sommer! - **Fresh apps** - That’s a lot to cover, so let’s dive right in. - You can really freshen up your apps with SwiftUI, from a new tab view, to beautiful mesh gradients, and snappy controls! - **Fresh apps: TabView** - Sam and I wrote a karaoke event planner app. - It’s primarily a side bar driven app, and in iOS 18.0, the sidebar has become a lot more flexible. - **Fresh apps: Presentation sizing** - Sheet presentation sizing is now unified and simplified across platforms. - You can use the .presentationSizing modifier to create perfectly-sized sheets with .form or .page, or even use custom sizing. - **Fresh apps: Zoom transition** - and I can use it to make expanding info on a party look gorgeous. - For more on the new TabView check out "Improve your tab and sidebar experience on iPad". - **Fresh apps: Custom controls** - custom resizable controls such as buttons and toggles that live in control center or the lock screen and can even be activated by the action button. - Controls are a new kind of Widget that that are easy to build with App Intents! - **Fresh apps: Vectorized and function plots** - Sam and I have been working hard to grow our karaoke party attendance. - I think an exponential function seems like very reasonable goal. - **Fresh apps: TableColumnForEach** - As a data nerd, I also like to keep track of how much the attendees are singing at the parties. - Using TableColumnForEach, I can now have a dynamic number of table columns for however many parties Sam and I have! -
